formula: C_effective = C_nominal * (1-initial_tolerance) * r_combined. r_combined covers DC bias, temperature under bias, aging and applicable AC test conditions.
caution: X5R/X7R ±15% temperature classification is specified without applied DC voltage. Multiplying a typical DC-bias curve by0.85 and0.90 is an illustrative engineering reserve only, not a guaranteed combined minimum. No curve values were read or invented.

critical_acceptance.basis: Project conservative criterion based on BQ OUT recommended nominal4.7–47µF; not a stated BQ DC-biased guarantee
critical_acceptance.qualification_temperature_note: Engineering electronics component qualification grid; +85°C is X5R body limit. Whole panel operation remains0..50°C. Three sample points alone do not guarantee the continuous temperature interval.
critical_acceptance.aging_and_ac_test_condition: Obtain vendor condition-specific data and record post-reflow time, bias dwell, AC test frequency/amplitude; no service-life or combined-aging minimum has been established. The illustrative10% aging reserve is not a vendor guarantee.
